bio: The location is a huge draw at what is the largest branch of this globally recognised restaurant brand. Part of the Four Seasons Hotel, this Nobu sits in a stunning futuristic building surrounded by water, located at the end of a narrow peninsula, and offers impressive views of the Corniche promenade. Choose from a wide range of Japanese dishes, with South American influences adding a lovely twist. An open kitchen, stylish bar and cool music ensure a chic atmosphere accompanies the food....
